meta.title: Controlled deposition of human neural stem cells on fiber substrates using gel encapsulation.

extracted_by: Claude (Claude Code session), pending human review
summary: A simple capillary 'bioprinter' deposited human neural stem cells in small alginate gel spots onto electrospun fibre mats, giving control over where cells sit.

formulations.review_notes: Alginate concentration and NSC source not captured.
formulations.name: Alginate gel spots on electrospun fibres
formulations.composition_detail: Alginate gelled in 20 mM Ca2+ medium; later removed with alginate lyase
formulations.key_outcome: Gel-encapsulated deposition placed hNSCs precisely on fibre substrates at low cost.

evidence.quote: the fiber substrate is soaked in a small volume of medium containing 20 mM Ca2+
we opted for a simpler approach where the nozzle remained stationary and only injected a single population of cells
